biography:
At Switch, our team is accelerating the expansion of Hyperscale Sales and Product offerings, integrating our groundbreaking data centers designs with renewable energy solutions, coupled with deep industry relationships to facilitate the CSP's and High-tech users sustainable growth. Our strategic vision leverages large campus-style projects, accelerated delivery timelines with safety being the forefront of our delivery platform and ensuring we meet the escalating demand for Hyperscale/ AI-ML solutions with the backing of two well capitalized investment firms, being Digital Bridge and IFM Investors.

My tenure at GLP fortified expertise in strategic planning, sales and technology implementation, skills that are now pivotal in managing Switch's extensive lease portfolio. The organization thrives on our collective mission to harness foresight in infrastructure development, delivering scalable, high-quality solutions that propel the Internet's evolution.
